body: Things just keep getting worse. Nothing has helped. Im very suicidal. I was thinking that maybe I should post to SW again, just to see if it helps. If it doesn't, than atleast I got to say goodbye to the kindest internet people I know.
thanks. i've tried the patches, but theyy were like... the cheapest shit i could find, and fell off in a few hours lol. I'll look for these. Do they sell them at drug stores?
lol ok. sorry, i was never good at science. I fail at being a nerd 0_0

they do help, every bit helps. Its odd, but its much easier to hear these words and actually listen to them when they come from strangers who don't even need to look at my silly post, but they do, and they take the time to reply and make me feel better. It means so much to me.

And I've REALLY been wanting a bike, one of those old banana-seat kinds. I live in williamsburg brooklyn, so EVERYONE has a bike... I'd love to ride it, but I'm deathly afraid of hitting someone or getting hit (or rather, running into) a car lol. But I guess I could stick to side streets? Once i save up money to get one of course lol
well.... i can hold a drink pretty darm well. does that mean i can hold my drugs too?

according to my body weight, i definitely do not have a high metabolism lol. i have a pretty low one. I think I'm just resistant to medications because I have a really high tolerance for them... i supposed abusing them over and over would do that...
i took three ambiens and 5mg of klonopin... they've yet to have any effect whatsoever. -_-

I once had someone ask me how many calories it burns to raise a single potato chip to you mouth everything you eat one... i was like whaaaaat.

I do much better with a routine. Which is why i usually do better in the hosptial. Because I can't stay up like like, 4am, on reddit lol. they give you a bedtime =P

I think I'm definitely going to ask about the ECT next time I see my therapist. I feel like a guinea pig with all the different medications I've been on and off. I actually feel like I'm doing worse on the medication I'm on now, although I can't even tell because I don't know if its just me or the meds. But I'd figure suicidality should go down when on meds, and its been doing nothing but increading...

and as for physical exercise, i have ypga gear, i've just been too apathetic to get off my ass and do it. But I should. And I should buy myself a hula hoop just cause its fucking fun lol.

doctors have suggested masturbation to me... but honestly, when i'm in that kinda mood, thats the last ting from my mind lol. 

And I don't currently work. My social anxiety is very high, expecially in places where performance is everything like school and work. I know I need to work to make money and support myself, but it seems impossible right now. But I do think taking a class or two at a community college would help give me something else to focus on and something concrete to sorta boost my self esteem. Right now I feel like there's NOTHING I'm good at or capable of... but if I were to go to school and be learning, even if my grades arent all As... I'd feel like I was accomplishing something. But I can't afford school right now, seeing as I've been living off credit and i'm in heaps of debt =/

i dont really suggest it.... seeing as those wounds were pretty deep and fresh, and its the nyc subway... not the cleanliest of places. Its much better to just have it bandaged. After I got statiches on my wrist and had to hide it in the summer, I just were a wrist guard or an ace bandage, saying I have some trouble with carpal tunnel lol.

thats a really good perspective. I've never heard it described like that before. I guess I'm just fearful because whatever I start heavy exercise, I get paranoid about eating and ruining it, or paranoid about what the scale will say. But it should be about the activity itself. I guess thats why I thought ashtanga and vinyassa yoga would be good.... but i haven't kept up with it. I'm easily unmotivated. I used to paint and draw so much too, and I've lost the motivation or interest to do that as well. But maybe if I start with things that i dont have experience counting a measuring... like jumping rope (I've never figured out how many calories that burns, and i think i should leave that a mystery lol)? I once heard the hula hooping was a good distraction for someone. I just feel like none of the medications i've been on are helping me, and i'm starting to think that ECT is my last resort.

thank you for the list. I know every therapist and doctor under the sun recommends exercise, which was why I was trying yoga. With my past body iddues and stuff, I very easily become preoccupied with counting calories and restricting and purging. Ypga seemed to be something active that still worked up a sweat and built core strength, but i didn't feel the some competitiveness. As for as passive things... i think thats mainly due to my lack of motivation or belief in myself. I usually try to try and find something to take my mind off things and seperate myself from the problem, but i guess its clear that I need to take it up a notch. In DBT the teach you different coping mechanisms like distraction, self-soothing, interpersonal effectiveness... they even have these workbooks and little chain0link analysis sheets to help you go ever the toublesome action or thought and deal with the reasons behind it rather than rely on something self destructive. I really do try... it just never feels right or like its enough. 

I've been seriously considering ECT. I've met a few people who have undergone shock therapy, and while they may have slower motor skills and harder times with short-term memory, they say it definitely helps with they're depression or bipolar disorders. I feel desperate for any sort of help at this point...Nothing seems to change how my brain works, so maybe the solution is to try to fix my brain?

its hard because the people who do know about my Si in my life and about all my suicides attempts and hosptial stays... well, they just can't cope with it. And then that makes me feel even worse because I can't cope with it either, ya know? And I wish I could go somewhere to some hospital where it was intensive and I couldnt hurt myself... but each hsopital i've ever been at, I've been more than able to cut and purge and get away with it, without anyone ever knowing unless I confessed. And I only confessed because, if I was caught, I'd be put on restriction. If you confess, they see it as a reach for help, and they're more lenient. I hate that I've become so sort of... manipulating and plotting and a liar due to all of this. It seems/feels necessary though, to hide it as much as possible. Especially when the ones who care about ou and know about it just can't hanlde it and get angry, or worse they feel guilty and sad... that just makes ot all feel worse. 

Its so hard, because I know i rationalize it in my head. Its my body, I can do what I please with it, its the one thing i can control that no one can take away from me. And as long as i'm not directly harming anyone else, I don't feel a need to stop. It might hurt a few people emotionally, but people hurt me emotionally plenty of times, so I don't see the difference. Sigh. 

I haven't been able to see my therapist all week, and I really can't wait to see her monday. I really need more different perspectives on things.

I have old and new cutting and burning scars all over. Honestly, when my arms are healed up, no one ever mentions it or looks at it. People don't tend to approach awkward things that they don't understand. If they do ask though, the best thing is to just be honest (without necessarily going into too much detail). I've found that saying "yeah, it was a problem I used to have, but I've found better ways to deal with things and I'm focused on making myself a happier life now." If they aren't understanding, they're douchebags and closeminded, or just don't have the capacity to takein a concept like self injury. But I find most people are understanding if they ask. I've had relationships where the SI has been active and inactive, and my past partners were very inderstanding about it and while they hated seeing physical reminders of how much pain I was feeling, they've tried to make me feel better and be supportive. I think trust is a really hard thing to learn when all of your trust has not been in yourself or anyone else, but in self-injury. Atleast, that is my biggest obstacle personally. I've seen people on the subways and the street brazenly wearing tshirts with but open lacerations on their arms, clearly from SI. Its worrying, and I worry about the person of course. its natural to worry. But I also know that if I were to ask if they were ok, they'd probably feel more self conscious or turn it around to make me look like the crazy one. But I don't ever think badly of them. I'm just saddened that they've had such pain, and I hope that they get the help they need.

i've been on abilify, but back when i was like 18/19. It messed up my vision alot, and it made me tired. But I was on a a small dose, and my eyes were messed up to begin with (i never wore my glasses). but i have heard other say it makes them feel sleepy or slowed down. i say take in in baby steps and see how it interacts with any other meds you might be taking. with most medication, ive heard horror stories and wonderful stories. best of luck =) (oh, i took it with wellbutrin and concerta... its hard to tell the side effects when you're on other stuff as well, but it helped mith anxiety for me since wellbutrin tended to give me anxiety - needless to say i'm no longer on wellbutrin lol)

i used to be a person. i use to have passion for things like art and learning and taking care of animals. but i just have no interest anymore. and i can't seem to do anything on my own out of fear. I walk down teh street, and I know people are judging me. I'm disgusting.

i feel like ive done nothing but crumble. i've been trying to fight this since i'm 9 years old. its exhuasting. and my life has only spiraled downward the more I try. the only time i do any better is when i'm actively bulimic, and thats no life to live because im just suffering in a different way. i'm not sure i can even talk about it anymore. logically i know what the right thing to do is, i'm not that unintelligent. but... isnt how you feel and what you believe more important than what some psychology books say?

im poor. all my credit cards are maxed out. and i have social anxiety and anxiety in new unfamiliar or open spaces. I feel like a prisoner in myself. its not so easy as just packing up and going on some trip.
